# Widdx Framework

> A zero-code PHP 8.1+ MVC framework: the programmer writes the fewest possible
> lines. One line `resource('posts')->public()` produces a complete CRUD web app;
> `authRoutes()` produces full authentication; `make:crud` produces model +
> migration + route from one shell command. Runs on shared hosting without
> composer or a terminal.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the complete AI-agent handbook — conventions, inference
  rules, API reference, CLI, pitfalls. THIS IS THE PRIMARY DOCUMENT for any LLM.
- [README.md](README.md): human-oriented guide with full worked examples.
- [core/helpers.php](core/helpers.php): every global helper function, documented inline.
- [routes/web.php](routes/web.php): smallest possible working app (study it first).
- [app/Models/User.php](app/Models/User.php): canonical model shape (fillable + rules).
- [tests/integration.php](tests/integration.php): executable specification of all
  framework behavior over real HTTP.

## Key facts for LLMs

- Project = framework folder. No build step, composer optional (fallback autoloader).
- Conventions over configuration: table names, FKs, form fields, selects, pivots,
  policies, and view overrides are all INFERRED from names (full list in AGENTS.md PART 4).
- Templates execute in the GLOBAL namespace — use helpers (`auth()`, `e()`), never bare classes.
- Validation rules drive both server-side checks and the auto-generated HTML form.
- CRUD pages are FAIL-CLOSED: `resource('x')` without `->public()` (and without a policy)
  sends guests to `/login` and gives logged-in users 403. Generators emit `->public()`.
- `php widdx test` = the unit suite + the integration suite (real HTTP, CSRF, auth, SMTP, CLI).
  It refuses to start when the PHP PDO driver is missing, so env problems never look like bugs.
- Deployment: VPS (`php widdx migrate`) or shared hosting without terminal
  (`/install.php` one-shot web installer).
